headline: CVS Health (CVS) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Turn More Constructive
summary: The fair value estimate for CVS Health has shifted from US$111.92 to US$114.88, signaling a modest reset in where analysts think the stock could be worth over time. This change lines up with recent research that leans constructive on CVS Health ahead of upcoming earnings, while still calling out execution and policy risks that could affect how closely the stock trades to that mark. headline: Leap Expands Manufacturer & Specialty Network Partnerships with Appointment of Industry Executive Christine Hummel
summary: NEW YORK, August 06, 2026--Leap, the healthcare company making specialty medicine more affordable and easier to access, today announced the appointment of Christine Hummel as Senior Vice President of Manufacturer and Specialty Network Partnerships. In this role, she will lead Leap's strategy and partnerships across pharmaceutical manufacturers and specialty care networks, helping expand access to specialty therapies through more transparent and efficient models of care.
